story.text: I did two main things there. One was the recommendation widget, that was in Python with scikit-learn, it suggests products on the product page. And the other, totally separate, was the invoice exporter, which is a script that generates PDFs for finance every month, I did that one with Go. The widget I did with another dev, but the exporter was just me.
